serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: Lady Annalie: Hello everyone! Bot: Hi Annalie, have you recovered since the last time? Lady Annalie: Sure thing! I gave myself a good night’s sleep and the next day I was feeling great! #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.sad Lady Annalie: There was only a teeny tiny discomfort in my head, back, ankle and a few other things, but that's beside the point! #bot.Expression.clear Lady Annalie: After suffering such a major loss last time, I’m ready to give my all! #Annalie_Outside.face.sad You: I see that you are still in these ridiculously tall platform shoes. Didn’t you learn anything? #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww Lady Annalie: Sorry, but the bowling shoes I ordered haven’t arrived yet. Don’t worry, I will manage to beat you today regardless! You: At least you are motivated. #Annalie_Outside.face.normal You: For today I thought that we could split into teams since I and Annalie are much weaker than you two. What do you think about it? #bot.Expression.happy Bot: Great idea! I want to be on a team with you! Well, I knew she would want that since she loves me and all. Bot: Your stats are better than Annalie’s, so it should give me better chances for winning! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy You: I-Is winning the only reason you want to be in a team with me? #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Bot: Yes? Should there be any other? #Cashier.Eyes.normal+Cashier.Mouth.hmmm You: N-No, never mind. Lady Annalie: Uwah~ That was embarrassing to witness. Melissa: She’s denser than I thought. #Cashier.Eyes.normal+Cashier.Mouth.hmmm Lady Annalie: They both are. That’s why it’s fun to hang out with them. Melissa: You really are twisted. #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Lady Annalie: Hey~ Don’t be like that, Melissa~ {{wi}} Lady Annalie: Anyway, do you think you will break your high record from last time? #Cashier.Face.shocked Melissa: … #Cashier.Face.normal Melissa: Sorry, I didn’t realize that someone was keeping the count. If you put all that energy into throwing the bowling ball instead of fooling around, maybe you will finish today’s game without any broken bones. #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: How harsh! Lady Annalie: It seems like we will be in one team, so please take care of me~ Melissa: That’s what I’m worried about. I guess I will take it easy today. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Lady Annalie: Already given up on me? That’s just cruel, Melissa~ Lady Annalie: I really want us to win this thing, you know? #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: So please, help me improve my hip work~ Melissa: … Melissa: Remember, you asked for it. Melissa: She’s going to throw first, is that ok with you two? You: No problem. Lady Annalie: Oh my~ Are we really going to do it~ #Annalie_Outside.face.suprised #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.shock Lady Annalie: Hya~! {{punch}} Annalie let out an immodest scream after Melissa came up to her from behind and with force grabbed her hip and ass cheek. Lady Annalie: M-Melissa-chan~ Aren’t you a little too forceful? Melissa: Hold still and listen. You want to keep your hips nice and square. #bot.Expression.veryshock #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Pervy+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww Lady Annalie: Kya~! {{punch}} Melissa: And as you throw, you want the rotation to be smooth and slow…{{wi}} Like this! Lady Annalie: Ah~! {{punch}} I don’t know if it was on purpose, but Annalie let out the lewdest sound as of yet…{{wi}} and got a strike… #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Closed+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy Lady Annalie: T-Thank you, Melissa…{{wi}} For showing me a completely new world~ Melissa: I have no idea what you are talking about, but please, stop with the weird sounds. #Annalie_Outside.face.normal #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.angry Bot: Wait a minute! Is that even allowed in team play?! Melissa pretty much did all the work! You: Cut them some slack. After all, it's just a friendly competition. #bot.Expression.clear Bot: If that’s the case, I’m going to help you throw too. #bot.Expression.angry You: No! That would be humiliating! Bot: We are going to lose otherwise! You: I’m fine with that. I would rather lose the game than the rest of my self-respect! Melissa: Come on, {f_botName}. It’s just a game. Bot: You are the last person I want to hear that from! #bot.Expression.clear You: Let’s continue playing, ok? #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: Are you sure it’s a good idea? Is there even a point to this game now that Melissa filled me up to the brim with the power of yuri bowling? You: I think I will take our chances… Melissa: What is yuri? You: You don’t want to know… Lady Annalie: If you are interested in yuri, Melissa, we can meet up later at my place and I will tell you everything about and by that I mean E~V~E~R~Y~T~H~I~N~G~. Melissa: Ew, no thanks. #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: No luck! It seems I got rejected! You: Alright, stop fooling around. It’s my turn. If every throw requires so much foreplay, we won’t finish this game today… You: Here I go! #bot.Expression.sad You: I think I did pretty well, there’s only one pin left. It should be an easy spare. Bot: It’s over… You: What do you mean ‘it’s over’! It was a good throw! Lady Annalie: It should be easy from now on since we are in the lead. Melissa: Yep. You: … It was a good throw. {{wi}}It was… Now is time for my second throw… The ball stayed close to the gutter, but in the end it managed to hit the last pin. You: Strike. Lady Annalie: Oh wow~ It’s a strike, good job! You: Yeah, it’s kinda too late for that, you all already sucked out all my energy. Bot: Don’t worry, {f_playerName}. I forgive you for failing our team. You: Thanks, I guess… Bot: But you have to promise me that now you will take this seriously, ok? You: Sure thing… #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.happy
